summary: Synchronously append data, creating the file when necessary and preserving append flags and encoding.

requirements.options_shape: statically known or represented by NodeFsOptions

semantics.mutation: appends without truncating; creates file if absent

caveats: Append-mode descriptor semantics are OS-specific; on Linux positional writes to an append fd still append.
Do not lower to read-concatenate-write; that changes atomicity/races and can lose concurrent appends.

tests.name: creates when absent
tests.expected_behavior: creates the file if absent and appends x
